public.hero.intro: Mecropolis ukax satatpach qillqat Open-Meteo junt'u thaya yatiyäwinakat jilawi junt'u urunaka jakthapi. Taqpachax yapun wakisir chimpur puripanx Western Cape yapuchäwir jutir saräwiruw apayi.

public.how.title: Sata urut saräwipkama
public.how.lead: Saräwix jilpachax amparamp qillqasi, ukat qhipa machaqachäwkamakiw chiqäspa. Akanx qillqat pachamp jakthapita, sapa mayjt'äwis kunatsa uk qillqasi.
public.step.1.title: Yapuchirin yatitap qillqaña
public.step.1.body: Yapunaka, yapu chiqanakapa, yapuchäwinaka ukat sata urunakax Sanity ukan imatawa.
public.step.2.title: Pasiri pacha yatiyäw apaqaña
public.step.2.body: Yapu chiqankir coordenadanakat sapür junt'u thaya yatiyäwix Open-Meteo imat yatiyäwit juti, satat jichhürukama.
public.step.3.title: Junt'u urunaka jakthapiña
public.step.3.body: Jilawi junt'u urunaka (GDD) yapuchäw uñacht'äwirjam jakthapisi. Wakisir chimpur puripanx askichirix yapuchäwir jutir saräwiruw apayi, kunatsa uk qillqaraki.
public.models.title: Apnaqat yapuchäw uñacht'äwinaka
public.models.lead: Junt'umpi puqur puriñatak wakisir junt'u urunaka. Aka chimpunakax amparamp qillqatawa, janirakiw kawkitsa apaqatätap qillqatäkiti.
public.live.title: Swartland yant'a yapun pacha
public.live.lead: Taqinitak yatiyäw churir chiqanakata, sapa 30 minutur machaqachata.
public.yields.title: Yatiyat achuyäw chimpunaka
public.honesty.title: Kunjam yatiyäw apnaqasi
public.honesty.1.title: Apnaqirix achuyäw qillqi
public.honesty.1.body: Irnaqirix achu qhawqha apsutapsa qillqantkani ukakamaxa, appax “Jani qillqatäkiti” siwa.
public.honesty.2.title: Uñacht'äwinakax yaqha qillqatanakawa
public.honesty.2.body: Suyump markamp yapuchäw yatiyawinakapax yaqha qillqatanakan imatawa, kawkhats apsutäki ukat kunamp tuputasa ukamp chika. Janiw yapun achupamp chikachaskiti.
public.honesty.3.title: Usunakax suyun qillqatawa
public.honesty.3.body: GBIF uñjäw qillqatanakax 100 km manqhan uñjatawa, qhawqha jayankisa ukamp chika.
public.honesty.4.title: Pachax jichha yatiyäwiwa
public.honesty.4.body: Mayit pachax Open-Meteo nayra qillqatanakat junt'u thaya yatiyäwinak apsusi.
public.open.title: Mä yapu mar jist'araña
public.open.body: Yant'äwi uñañ chiqar mantam, mä yapu maran GDD siqipa ukat kunatsa uka pachankisa uk uñjañataki.
public.live.unavailable: {source} yatiyäwix jichhax janiw utjkiti ({reason}). Lanti janiw kunas uñacht'ayaskiti.
public.live.weatherChart: Arsuñ urunakan sapa uru juk'amp thaya, juk'amp junt'u ukat jallu
public.live.pestsLead: Yaput {radius} km manqhan kawkhankisa ukamp qillqata yatiyäwinaka.
public.yield.lead: Aka kimsa siqinakax yaqha tuqit yaqha jach'a chiqanak taypin tupupxi. Janiw jupanakkamas ni kuna yapumpis chikachaskaspati.
public.about.title: Uñt'añataki
public.about.heading: Mecropolis tuqita
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ukax Cabo Occidental uksan mä yapun yapunaka ukat achunak arkiriwa.
public.about.why.title: Kunatakis utji
public.about.why.body: Yapun saräw qillqatanakapax nayrar tukxi, achunakasti amuyut qillqantasi. Mecropolis ukax qillqat pachampiw saräw jakhu. Sapa jakhuw irnaqirit jan ukax sutini taqin uñjkañ yatiyäwit juti.
public.about.design.title: Wakichäwi
public.about.design.1.body: Yapuchat urut qalltasaw junt'u urunaka (GDD) Open-Meteo nayra qillqatanakamp tantachasi. Sapa saräw mayjt'äwix kunamp uñacht'ayatasa uk imasi: kuna urut qallti, GDD taqpacha ukat kunats jakhsutasa.
public.about.design.2.body: Apsuñ nayra saräw qhipankirix junt'ump puquta satawa, kunattix apthapiñax janiw qillqatäkiti.
public.about.design.4.body: Jupanakax yaqha qillqatanakan imatawa, kawkhats apsutäki, kunamp tuputa ukat licencia ukamp chika.
public.about.stack.title: Apnaqat yänaka
public.about.stack.body: Cloudflare Pages ukan Vite ukat React 19 ukan mä sapa-página app. Navegadorax taqin uñjkañ Sanity yatiyäwinak GROQ ukamp chiqak ullari, ukat pachpa pachan ist'iri. Qillqañanakasa llave yatiyäwinakasa Cloudflare Pages Functions tuqiw sari; ukax firmat sesión cookie uñakipi. Qawayakan Zod, yant'añataki Vitest, ukat uñnaqapataki Tailwind 4.
public.about.limits.title: Uñt'at jan phuqatanaka
public.about.limits.1: Yapu modelo jakhunaka (qallta junt'u, mistuñatak junt'u pacha ukat puqutäñatak junt'u pacha) amparamp qillqatawa, jichhakamax janiw kawkhats apsutäki ukax utjkiti.
public.about.limits.2: Lupino uñacht'äwix HarvestStat ukan 2000 ukat 2007 marakamakiwa, ukat qallta apnaqäwix janiw kuna lupino uñacht'äw qillqatsa jikxatkänti.
public.about.limits.3: Usunakan yatiyäwipax yapu jak'an GBIF uñjäw qillqatanakawa. Kawkhans mä kasta yapu jak'an qillqatäna uk uñacht'ayi.
public.about.limits.4: Yant'äwix taqinitak mä mantañakiwa, ukat memoria manqhan mayiwi juk'aptayiri utji. Mantañax tablero páginas imanti, ukampis janiw yatiyäwinak jark'aqkiti: taqiniw ullapxaspa. Ukampis taqi qillqañanak jark'aqi.

docs.title: Qillqat yatichäwi
docs.heading: Wakichaña ukat API
docs.lead: Mecropolis uka pachpa computadoran kunjam apnaqaña ukat mantañ thakhinakapax kun lurisa.
docs.setup.title: Wakichaña
docs.setup.serves: Appax {0} ukan irnaqi, ukat {1} ukax {2} ukan Pages Functions ukar apayi. Navegadoran wakichäwipax mä módulo tuqiw ullasi, Functions ukasti jupan wakichäwip uñakipi; mä variable jan utjipanxa janiw maynis qalltkiti.
docs.env.title: Entorno variables
docs.env.fasKey: USDA FAS PSD mantañataki, Functions ukatakiki
docs.stages.title: Saräw makina
docs.stages.intro: Yapu maranakax suxta saräw tuqiw nayrar sari:
docs.stages.guards: Sapa saräwir mantañatakix mä uñakipäwi utji. Yapuchatäñatakix yapuchat uru ukat achu munasi; jiltañatakix mistuñ GDD qurpapa; apthapiñ nayratakix puqutäñ qurpan 90%; junt'ump puqutäñatakix puqutäñ qurpa pasaña; uñakipañatakix yapu maran pacha yatiyäwipa ukat chiqanchat uñacht'äwi. GDD uñakipäwinakax pachan 90% ukatak junt'u thaya yatiyäwi munaraki, ukat jutïr urun qalltir saräwix jark'atawa.
docs.endpoints.title: Mantañ thakhinaka
docs.endpoints.errors: Pantjasiñanakax {0} kutt'ayi. Qillqañatakix pachpa sitio ukan mayiwip munaraki.
docs.ep.recsPost: Mä yapu maratak iwxt'awi borradorjam amtaña
docs.ep.recsAction: Mä iwxt'awi iyawsaña, janiw saña jan ukax tukuyaña
docs.ep.advance: Mä yapu mar GDD ukarjam nayrar apaña (sesión ukatakix seasonId munasi), jan ukax bearer ukamp taqi yapu maranak nayrar apaña
docs.ep.scenario: GDD ukax kunjamaspasa uk jakhuña; janiw kunas imaskiti
docs.ep.weather: Yaputak pacha yatiyäwi, nayra yatiyäwi jan ukax jutïr pacha amuyäwi
docs.ep.pests: Uka tuqinkir GBIF uñjäwinaka; POST ukar imasi
docs.ep.landing: Yant'a yaputak pacha, uraqi, laq'unaka ukat achunaka
docs.ep.conditions: Mä yaputak pacha, uraqi ukat laq'unaka
docs.seed.title: Qalltayaña
docs.seed.body: {0} ukax wakichat yatiyäwinakar yant'a yapu, yapuchañ uraqinaka, achunaka ukat yapu maranaka qillqi, ukat uka tuqinkir tupunakamp chikachasi. Yapu, yapuchañ uraqinaka ukat achunaka lantintani; ukhamasti juman yatiyäwimampiki apnaqam.
guide.title: Mecropolis kunjam apnaqaña
guide.lead: Akax sapuru arunakamp qillqat jisk'a yatichäwiwa. Appax kunatakisa, khitinakatakisa ukat sapa chiqax kunsa luraski uk qhanañchi.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis kunasa
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis ukax yapunakan uraqinakapa ukat achunakapa uñjañatakiwa. Sata urutpach q'uñi pachanak jakt'asaw sapa achux qawqha jiltatasa uk yati, ukat yapuman pacha, uraqi ukat laq'unak mä chiqan uñacht'ayi.
guide.what.p2: Sudáfrica markan Western Cape tuqinkir yapunakatak luratawa, ukampis kawkïr yapuna, kawkïr tuqina ukat kawkïr yapu maransa apnaqasispawa.
guide.who.title: Khitinakatakisa
guide.who.p1: Yapuchañ uraqinak uñjir jaqitakiwa, sañäni yapuchiri, yapu apnaqiri jan ukax jupanakar yanapir yatxatata.
guide.who.p2: Computadora jan ukax pacha tuqit yatxatañ janiw wakiskiti. Mä sitio web jist'arañ yatsta ukhax Mecropolis apnaqasmawa.
guide.why.title: Kunatakis apnaqasma
guide.why.1: Kawkïr achunakasa jichhak satata, jiltaski jan ukax niya apthapiñatak wakichata uk mä uñtawik uñjasma.
guide.why.2: Sapa yapuchañ uraqi amparamp machaqachañ janiw wakiskiti. Pachax horasawa sasin uñacht'ayki ukhax appax sapa achurux jupa pachpa nayrar sarayi.
guide.why.3: Jutïr urunakan juyphi ukat sinti junt'u utjani ukhax yatiyi, ukhamarak yapum jak'an uñjat laq'unakatsa.
guide.why.4: Mä yapuchañ uraqit qillqat taqi kunasa, sañäni fumigaña, uñjat laq'u jan ukax mä qillqata, urupamp chikaw mä chiqan imasi. Qhipat uñakipasmawa.
guide.why.5: Sapa jakhuw kawkhats jutki uk uñacht'ayi, ukhamat kawkïrir atinisiñsa yatiñamataki.
guide.heat.title: Kunjams appax achun jilïwip yati
guide.heat.p1: Quranakax q'uñïki ukhax juk'amp jank'akiw jilapxi, thaya pachanx juk'amp k'achaki. Mecropolis ukax sapa uru aka q'uñïwi jakt'i. Yatxatatanakax juñïwi tupunaka, jan ukax GDD, sapxiwa.
guide.heat.p2: Sapa urux juk'amp junt'u ukat juk'amp thaya temperaturan chikata apsu, ukat achux janiw jilxiti siski uka temperatura apaqi. Jiltki ukax uka urun q'uñïwi tupunakapa. Mä thaya urux janiw kunsa yapxatkiti.
guide.heat.p3: Sapa achux puqurñatak mä qawqha q'uñïwi tupunakwa muni. Sata urutpach tantacht'at tupux uka jakhur jak'achaski ukhax achux jutïr jilïwiruw sari.
guide.heat.p4: Temperaturanakax Open-Meteo ukat juti. Ukax uraqpachan sapa chiqan pachap qillqir inaki pacha yatiyäwiwa.
guide.stages.title: Suxta jilïwi
guide.stages.intro: Sapa yapuchañ uraqin sapa achux aka jilïwinak aka siqirjamaw saraski.
guide.stages.planning: Yapu marax wakichatawa, ukampis achux janïraw satatäkiti.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Achux munat q'uñïwipat jilpach tantachxi. Apthapiñatak wakichasiñ pachawa.
guide.stages.harvested: Achux taqpach munat q'uñïwip tantachxi, ukhamasti wakichatäñapawa. Jumakiw chiqpach apthapitati janicha uk yatisma; ukatwa appax q'uñïwimp puquta sasin sutichi.
guide.stages.review: Yapu marax tukusxiwa, kunjam sarataps uñakipasmawa.
guide.stages.p2: Appax sapa aruma sapa ach uñakipi, ukhamarak maynix mä uñjäwi jan ukax luräwi yapxatki ukhaxa. Jank'ak uñakipañatakix yapu maran Jichhaki chikachaña limt'asma.
guide.start.title: Qalltaña
guide.start.1: Qallta uñstaw jist'aram. Jan mantañampis yant'a yapun pacha mapapa, uraqi, laq'unaka ukat achunaka uñjasma.
guide.start.2: Alayankir Mantaña limt'am, ukat churat yant'a cuenta yatiyäwinak apnaqam.
guide.start.3: Mä yapu ajllim. Ukax uka yapun uñakipañ uñstawip jist'ari.
guide.start.4: Mä yapu mara limt'am, uka yapuchañ uraqin uka achut taqi kun uñjañataki.
guide.start.5: Arun mayjt'ayañatakix kawkïr uñstawinsa alayankir aru kajuna apnaqam. Appax jutïr kutitak ajllitam amti.
guide.home.title: Qallta uñstawi
guide.home.p1: Qallta uñstawix aka yapu maran uraqix qawqha q'uñïwi katuqasa ukarjam samichat mapa uñacht'ayi. Jichha pacha, jutïr urunakan pacha, yant'a yapun uraqipa, aka qhipa urunakan jak'an uñjat laq'unaka ukat uka tuqin achu taypi tupus uñacht'ayi. Uñjañatakix janiw mantañamäkiti.
guide.dashboard.title: Yapu uñakipañ uñstawi
guide.dashboard.intro: Uñakipañ uñstawix mä yapu uñacht'ayi. Akax alayat aynacharjam chiqanakapawa. Alayankir yapu kajunax yaqha yapur sarañ yanapt'i.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Yapu juk'achäwi
guide.dashboard.summary: Qawqha yapuchañ uraqisa ukat qawqha ha ukani, qawqha yapu marasa saraski, ukat qawqha achusa wakichata.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Uñjañawa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Jisk'a yatiyäwinaka: jutïr pachan juyphi jan ukax junt'u, wakichat achu, pachapar jan qalltat yapu mara, jan ukax yapuchañ uraqi jak'an uñjat laq'unaka. Sapa yatiyäwix kunats utji uk siwa.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Yapun kunjamäskisa
guide.dashboard.conditions: Jichhür pacha, jutïr pacha, uraqi ukat aka yapu jak'ankir laq'unaka.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Yapu maran saräwipa
guide.dashboard.progress: Sapa achut mä tarjeta, qawqha q'uñïwips tantachxi uk uñacht'ayi. Yapuchañ uraqinak mayacht'ata uñakipasma, ukat lista hoja de cálculo (CSV) ukar apaqasma.
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Yapuchañ uraqinaka
guide.dashboard.fields: Yapun taqi yapuchañ uraqinakapa, jach'a tupupa, uraqipa ukat achunakapa.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Qillqatanak thaqaña
guide.dashboard.search: Kuntï thaqkta uk sapuru arunakamp qillqt'am, sañäni trigo patan pulgones. Yaqha arunak apnaqapkchisa, pachpa amuyun uñjäwinaka ukat luräwinak jikxati.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Iwxt'awinaka
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Mä yapuchañ uraqitak iwxt'at lurañanaka, sañäni fumigaña jan ukax abono uchaña. Sapa maynir iyaw jan ukax janiw sasaw ajllisma, ukat tukuyasax lurataw sasaw chimpuchasma.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Qhipa luräwinaka
guide.dashboard.activity: Sapa achux machaq jilïwir sarat urunakan listapa.
guide.season.title: Yapu mara uñstawi
guide.season.intro: Mä yapu marax mä maran mä yapuchañ uraqin mä achuwa. Uñstawipanx taqi yatiyäwipaw utji.
guide.season.top.label: Uñstawin alayapa
guide.season.top: Achu, yapuchañ uraqi, sata uru, suyt'at apthapiñ uru ukat qillqt'at achu qawqha.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Jilïwinakan siqipa
guide.season.pipeline: Suxta jilïwi, jichhankir jilïwix chimpuntata. Achux nayrar sarañapacha janicha uk jank'ak uñakipañatakix Jichhaki chikachaña limt'am.
guide.season.readiness.label: Nayrar sarañatak wakichata
guide.season.readiness: Appax achur nayrar sarayañatak kuntï munki ukanakan listapa, sañäni sata uru ukat wakiskir pacha yatiyäwi. Sapa maynix Waliki, Yatiyäwi jan ukax Jark'ata siwa. Jark'atax kunas ch'usaski uk siwa.
guide.season.evidence.label: Qhananchirinaka
guide.season.evidence: Appax amtañatak apnaqat qillqatanaka, juman uñakipañamataki.
guide.season.propose.label: Mä iwxt'awi uchaña
guide.season.propose: Aka yapuchañ uraqitak mä lurañ iwxt'am, yapu maran qhananchirinakapamp chikata. Maynix uñakipañ uñstawin iyaw sañapkama borradorjam suyt'i.
guide.season.gdd.label: Jilïwi q'uñïwi urunaka
guide.season.gdd: Sata urutpach q'uñïwi tupunak kunjam tantachaski uk uñacht'ayir gráfico, achux qawqha munki uka siqimpi.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ukhamäspa ukhasti?
guide.season.whatIf: Nayra jan ukax qhipa sata uru, jan ukax juk'amp junt'u jan ukax thaya yapu mara yant'am; q'uñïwi tupunak kunjam mayjt'aspa uk uñjam. Janiw kunas imaskiti.
guide.season.summary.label: Yapu mara juk'achäwi
guide.season.summary: AI ukamp qillqat yapu maran qillqatanakapat jisk'a juk'achäwi. Yanapirjam ullaram, ukat kunas pantjatjam uñstani ukhax qillqatanak uñakipam.
guide.season.notes.label: Yapu mara qillqatanaka
guide.season.notes: Yapu maran urump qillqatanaka. Yapxataña, mayjt'ayaña ukat chhaqtayaña, ukhamarak nayra qillqata wasitat kutt'ayaña wakisiwa.
guide.season.files.label: Yapuchañ uraqin fotopa ukat uraqi yant'äwi yatiyäwi
guide.season.files: Yapuchañ uraqin mä fotopa ukat laboratorio uraqi yant'äwi PDF apkatam.
guide.season.log.label: Yapuchañ uraqi qillqata
guide.season.log: Yapuchañ uraqin kuntï uñjkta (uñjäwinaka) ukat kuntï lurkta (luräwinaka, sañäni kuna qullumpi ukat qawqha fumigatasa).
guide.season.history.label: Mayjt'äwinakan sarnaqäwipa
guide.season.history: Aka yapu maran sapa imat mayjt'äwi, urupampi.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Uka tuqin taypi tupu
guide.season.benchmark: Taqinitak jakhunakat apsut uka tuqin taypi achu. Uñakipañatakikiwa, janiw yapuchañ uraqiman achupäkiti.
guide.season.pests.label: Uka tuqin laq'u uñjäwinaka
guide.season.pests: GBIF ukan yapuchañ uraqi jak'an yatiyat laq'unaka. GBIF ukax taqinitak uñjäwi yatiyäwinak imir chiqawa. Machaq uñjäwinak katuqañatakix Uñjäwinak apaniña limt'am.
guide.sources.title: Jakhunakax kawkhats juti
guide.sources.weather: Jichhür pacha, jutïr pacha ukat pasat urunakan pachapax Open-Meteo ukat juti.
guide.sources.soil: Uraqi yatiyäwix SoilGrids ukat juti, ukax uraqpachan uraqi mapapawa.
guide.sources.pests: Laq'u uñjäwinakax GBIF ukat juti, ukax taqinitak uñjäwi yatiyäwinak imir chiqawa.
guide.sources.yields: Uka tuqin achunakax USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ukat Banco Mundial ukat juti.
guide.sources.you: Mayni taqi kunasa, sañäni qillqatanaka, luräwinaka ukat juman achunakamaxa, jumasa jan ukax irnaqir masinakamaw qillqt'apxta.
guide.limits.title: Kuntï jan lurkaspati
guide.limits.model: Sapa achux qawqha q'uñïwi tupu munki ukax nanakan jakhu amuyunakajawa, janïraw yapuchañ uraqin yant'atäkiti. Irpirjam apnaqam, ukat yapuchañ uraqiman kuntï uñjkta ukar atinisim.
guide.limits.maturity: Junt'u tantachäw phuqhatax, pachax yapux puqutawa siwa. Chiqapunit puqutati janicha, jumakiw yatta.
